name: Pernod Ricard SA
summary: Pernod Ricard SA produces and sells wines and spirits worldwide. The company offers whiskey, vodka, gin, rum, liqueur and bitters, champagne, tequila and mezcal, and aperitif under the brands Ricard, Mumm, Perrier-Jouët, Martell, Malibu, Ballantine's, Chivas, Beefeater, Jameson, Havana Club, Royal Salute, The Glenlivet, Absolut, KI NO BI, The Chuan, Midleton Very Rare, Rabbit Hole, Royal Salute, Secret Speyside, Avion, Elyx Vodka, L'Orbe, Italicus, Lillet, Pernod, Suze, Augier, Malfy, Jefferson's, Lot No. 40, Powers, Redbreast, Smooth Ambler, TX, Method & Madness, Monkey 47, Plymouth Gin, Ceder's, Green Spot, Aberlour, Scapa, Altos, Del Maguey, Ostoya, Pastis 51, ARARAT, Seagram's Gin, Kahlú…
